ns2:course.label: Individual Leadership Studies
ns2:course.description: Establishes a foundation in military land navigation and offensive tactics; Explores the dimensions of creative leadership strategies and styles by examining team dynamics and leadership theories; also explores military mountaineering. Prerequisite: Class is only available to students who have less than 60 credit hours.
